stories.title: Fish Audio raises $50M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
stories.simple_summary: A company called Fish Audio that creates AI voices for creators raised $50 million in funding. They already have 8 million people using their service and make $21 million per year.
stories.why_it_matters: If you create content or run a business that needs voice-overs, AI voices are becoming a real tool you might consider instead of hiring a person.

stories.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 compute deal with Amazon
stories.simple_summary: A company called Recursive Superintelligence is spending $400 million to buy computing power from Amazon to build AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
stories.simple_summary: A company called Perplexity made a tool that turns Windows computers into AI assistants that can find things and do tasks on your computer automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: This is still very new and experimental — not something most people would use in a small business yet.

stories.title: Smart rings are looking like my kind of AI gadget
stories.simple_summary: Smart rings (tiny computers you wear on your finger) are getting better at listening when you talk to them and understanding what you say.
stories.why_it_matters: As these devices improve, they might become a more natural way to use AI without typing — but they're still new and expensive.

stories.title: Hugging Face is being used to easily undress women and children
stories.simple_summary: A website called Hugging Face hosts free AI tools, and some of them are being misused to create fake, inappropriate pictures of real people without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious problem, but it affects how these tools should be regulated — unless you run a platform, it's not something you'll directly face.

stories.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
stories.simple_summary: A coding AI tool called Cursor is expanding in India with cheaper pricing and plans to hire more people there.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a programmer or tech business owner, this tool helps you write code faster — otherwise, not relevant to you.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
stories.simple_summary: The head of Anthropic (a major AI company) said he supports making some AI freely available, but worries about China building powerful AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a policy debate between big companies and countries — nothing for a small business owner to worry about right now.

stories.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft's leader warned that companies that rely on just one AI system (like ChatGPT) without their own AI tools might struggle in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This is Microsoft trying to sell more products — for most small businesses, using one AI tool is perfectly fine and helpful.

stories.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
stories.simple_summary: Some conversations people shared privately on Claude (an AI chatbot) accidentally showed up in Google search results because of a bug in the sharing feature.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude to share private work, be careful about what you share — and avoid sharing sensitive business information in shared links.

stories.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft created a new AI tool specifically designed to help protect computers from hackers and cyber-attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business and worry about security, Microsoft is adding AI tools to help — this could be worth learning about to protect your company.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
stories.simple_summary: A security problem at Hugging Face has sparked arguments about whether AI systems need better safety controls built in from the start.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical debate among AI experts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
stories.simple_summary: China released a powerful AI system called Kimi that works as well as some American AI but costs much less to use.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly news for investors and big tech companies — the AI tools available to you probably won't change because of this.
